title: Rehab Agent person model
description: PERSON/person.json (pipeline/rehabtwin/person.py, docs/person-model.md): what is known about one person, where each value came from, and which twin layer (docs/accuracy.md) it fills. Every session of the person uses it. No direct identifiers: person_ref is pseudonymous.

version.description: Raised on every change; earlier versions are in history/person_vNNN.json.

synthetic.description: Built from a synthetic session (tests): only synthetic sequences may use it.

sex.description: As the reference data record it (NHANES: recorded sex); with anthropometrics.age_years it sizes the leg muscles when no scan does.

measured.description: false: an assumed value, never used where a measured one is required.

generic_model_sha256.description: The scale factors apply to this generic model only; process refuses another.

built_from.description: The calibration session the scale factors came from, or method 'skel' (person bones).

provenance.description: Copy of the model-provenance record (pipeline/rehabtwin/tiers.py) next to person.json.

segments.description: Joint-centre distances of the model in its default pose, m.

keypoint_segments.description: Distances between model markers (e.g. LHip-LKnee), as rehabtwin kinect's segment check uses them, m.

muscle_imaging.description: Measured muscle size and quality from MRI/CT segmentation (pipeline/rehabtwin/capacity.py): per labelled muscle or group and side, volume in cm³ and/or MRI proton-density fat fraction (0-1). Muscles it covers get Fmax from the measured contractile volume; the rest from height and mass.

bone_density.description: DXA or QCT bone density with its screening category (pipeline/rehabtwin/bone.py). Not part of the OpenSim model; load what-ifs show it.

alignment.description: Skeletal alignment (pipeline/rehabtwin/alignment.py): the person's standing knee angles, leg lengths, pelvis and shoulders, from a clinician's or imaging record or a session's standing frame. knee_frontal_deg is the mechanical axis, + valgus; applied to the knee of every session's model. structural_flags: joint/planes where posture cues wait for a clinician-set target.

dxa.description: Whole-body DXA regional table (pipeline/rehabtwin/dxa.py): leg muscle per leg from leg lean mass, segment mass distribution from each region's share of the scanned mass, regional fat.

lean_kg.description: lean soft tissue without bone mineral

checks.description: distribution: all six regions with lean, fat and BMC (segment masses can follow the scan); mass_check: scanned vs measured mass.

skel_bones.description: Bones from body shape (pipeline/rehabtwin/skel_bones.py): SKEL's anatomical joint centres for the person's SMPL surface or height and mass, as segment lengths and per-body scale factors for the generic model. vs_model_cm: SKEL minus the session-built model, per segment.

surface_shape.description: Body surface fitted to depth (Tier B surface layer); see docs/person-model.md.
